'''Holt''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and commanded a mission to recover [[Celeste Morne]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. After both Morne and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] task force which included [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] escaped the moon, Holt was transformed into a rakghoul by Morne through the [[Muur Talisman]].<ref name="SW Rebellion: Vector" />
